This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

Shri Devendra Kumar Patidar, Superintendent of Police Burhanpur along with Shri Birju Goyal, T.I.,
Nepanagar, Burhanpur is present in the Court.
He assures that complete case diary will be sent to the Advocate General Office in future for perusal and consideration of this Court promptly.
This is the second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is pointed out that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the case and he has not committed any offence in any manner.
This repeat application has been filed on the ground of custody period of the present applicant.
It is pointed out by the State counsel that all the witnesses have been examined before the Trial Court.
Only the DNA report at the time of final arguments are required to be considered by the learned Trial Court.
The next date before the learned Trial Court is reported to be 01.09.2023.
Under these circumstances, when all the witnesses have been examined before the Trial Court, this Court is not inclined to allow the application.
The application is hereby rejected.

(VISHAL MISHRA) JUDGE AM Vakil Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101107870/
